name: Hahaoya Saimin Nikki ~Tamaki Sachiko no Ganbou~
original_name: 母親催眠日記 ～環幸子の願望～
source:
Sachiko Tamaki, the mother of the protagonist, is devoted to his education, and her goal is to turn him into an elite. Sachiko had originally intended to become a bureaucrat, but her marriage has closed the door to that goal.

Sachiko has been giving him a gifted education since he was a child. However, the overbearing, restricting, and simply painful life he leads fosters in him anger toward his mother and a distorted desire to make amends for his past resentment. 

The protagonist learns a special hypnotism from his bad friends and decides to use it to take revenge on his mother. 
What awaits him in the end?

[From [url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf006/index.html#spec]official site[/url]]
translation:
玉木幸子是主人公的母亲，一心投入儿子的教育，目标是把他培养成精英。幸子原本想成为官僚，但婚姻让她与这个目标失之交臂。

从主人公小时候起，幸子就对他进行英才教育。然而，这种专横、束缚、令人痛苦的生活，在他心中培育出对母亲的怨恨，以及想要弥补过去怨念的扭曲欲望。

主人公从坏朋友那里学会了特殊的催眠术，决定用它向母亲复仇。

等待他的最终结局是什么？

[摘自[url=http://www.lpv-gamesoft.com/bh/bihf006/index.html#spec]官方网站[/url]]
